scope: Internal incremental dense split ordinary f32 SwiGLU research requests; not signed Capsule/model qualification
captureOrder: energies = request.takeEnergies() after prefill completion transfers owned GPU tensors
pipeline.resetGenerationState() closes and clears request; caller retains transferred energies
deriveFreeze: Fresh reference prefill with its independently declared exact span; never slice old hidden states after removing instruction.
Await submitted work; freezeChannelGains([{layerIdx,channels,gains}]) copies into private GPU storage, validates finite positive values, hashes bytes.
Both cache arms borrow the SAME opaque frozen handle; close requests before frozen.close().
baseCacheOrder: Reset sequence, perform unmodified full prefillWithLogits.
Attach apply request with cacheArm:"base-cache", frozenGains:handle and gainHash:handle.gainHash.
Sample first token from BASE prefill logits.
For each continuation use decodeStepLogits with exact accumulated prefix per pipeline contract.
Capture teacher-forced cache diagnostics separately from natural samples. Reset closes request.
rePrefillOrder: Attach apply request cacheArm:"re-prefill" with same frozen handle and hash.
Perform full prefillWithLogits; do not recalculate statistics/gains.
First logits come from transformed full prefill; subsequent single-token decode uses same gains.
controls: controlChannelGains(recorderOrNull,sourceGains,{channels,mode:"permuted",seeds:GPUBuffer}) consumes independent SHA u32 permutation indices.
mode:"random-z" consumes independent SHA uniform f32 seed values; shader centers them, matches RMS(log(sourceGains)), exponentiates.
No readback/CPU-transform/upload of gains; host seeds never depend on model tensors.
Control outputs remain caller-owned; settle then freeze using same opaque API.
unsupported: MoE, ungated or non-SiLU activation, paired/f16 activations, combined gateUp weights and fused gate/up paths
LoRA simultaneous with channel gains; trained adapter comparator uses separate requests
Chunked or reused-prefix capture/re-prefill; exact full prompt required
Prepared decode workspace with active channel-gain request
General streaming generate() with attached request: use explicit incremental prefill/decode order
Attaching/resetting gains during active generation or supported incremental operations
cacheObservation: Contiguous kvCache: await syncToCPU(); use kv.layerIndices for model-index mapping and copy only seqLen*kvSize valid elements from each local layer.
Paged/other cache layouts require separate supported extraction; missing buffers are unavailable, never zero.
cloneLinearAttentionRuntime from linear-attention.js synchronizes and copies per-layer convState/recurrentState including precision/components metadata.
Compare same forced prefix and report KV, recurrent state and output/logits separately.
remaining: Full exact-model source/runtime/adapter provisioning and identity checks
End-to-end smoke/control/comparator orchestration and measured model timing
Model-state cache comparison under same forced prefix
Frozen selection/confirmation campaign under declared budget; no toy success establishes it.
